content.outro: Behind you the captain is down off his plinth, and the hall has one figure fewer.
content.premise: The Sentinel Hall at Varrow keeps the figures of the old watch: armoured dead set on plinths along the carpet, each where it fell asleep on its post. The keeper lets visitors walk the hall to the far door and touch what they like. The figures do not wake. Nearly all of them.
content.theme: A long stone hall of armoured statues on plinths, lit by hanging lanterns, where every figure answers a blow in its own way.
content.title: The Sentinels
